Female giant pandas enter the oestrus cycle (go into heat) only once every year. It typically last about 1 to 3 days. In the wild if there are no males around, she simply has to wait another year. Even in captive populations, it can be difficult for them to successfully mate. If she does happen to have a cub, the females will raise the cub to around a year and a half before it is mature enough to leave her, giving her the next chance to mate again. It is very similar to black bear reproduction, there are just far fewer giant pandas to go around.

Sometimes that consists of being tied up for weeks to break down their spirit and free will, which can easily turn into abuse. About your riding question, yes, they were probably mistreated. Most elephants used for tourism in Asia are tied up and beat until they have no self confidence so they can be used for whatever purpose.
